notes.title: Devlog: Making Avaricity: New Shadows More Accessible
notes.content:
Hello, fellow adventurers! It's Mystic here, the solo developer behind Avaricity: New Shadows. Today, I want to share an exciting update that will make a big difference for many potential players: I've decided to make the game half-off permanently. Here’s why I did it and what I hope to achieve with this change.
Half off? Are you crazy?!?

No, I just believe games should be as accessible as possible, and here is why! :

    Accessibility: By lowering the price, I aim to make Avaricity: New Shadows accessible to a broader audience. Everyone should have the opportunity to experience the game without financial strain.
    Community Growth: A larger player base means a more vibrant and active community. This enhances the game experience, even for a single-player game, as players share tips, stories, and fan content.
    Positive Impact: I want to impact the gaming community positively. Offering the game at a lower price is a way to give back to fans and supporters who have been with me since the beginning. It also provides the positivity of people being able to start at the first game and be there as the story progresses in future game iterations. Removing the fear of being left out!
    Longevity: A more affordable game can lead to increased sales over time, ensuring the longevity and continued development of Avaricity: New Shadows. This means more updates, more content, and more support for players. 

Join the Adventure

If you haven’t yet experienced Avaricity: New Shadows, now is the perfect time to join the adventure. With the new pricing, I hope to welcome even more players into this world. Together, we can continue to explore, discover, and shape the future of Avaricity.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Here’s to new shadows and new adventures!


Stay connected with me on social media for the latest updates and community events. I look forward to seeing you in-game!

Happy gaming!

Mystic
